INDONESIAN TEXT OVERLAY — COMMUNITY EXPERIMENTAL DRAFT

The Indonesian overlay was produced locally using Helsinki-NLP OPUS-MT en-id
(2019-12-18) through CTranslate2 int8 CPU inference and SentencePiece, with
additional manually authored menu/common-word terminology. It is not an
official THQ/Nickelodeon/Pandemic localization and has not had complete human
contextual review. Names, trademarks and song titles may remain unchanged.

Model/card: https://huggingface.co/Helsinki-NLP/opus-mt-en-id
Original model: https://object.pouta.csc.fi/OPUS-MT-models/en-id/opus-2019-12-18.zip
Model license: Apache License 2.0; see OPUS-MT-APACHE-2.0.txt.
OPUS-MT: J. Tiedemann and S. Thottingal, "OPUS-MT — Building open translation
services for the World", EAMT 2020.

The inference model, CTranslate2, SentencePiece, original English locale
catalogs and original game TRB/audio/image assets are not included in the
installed package. Indonesian UTF-16 strings are compiled into the runtime,
indexed by hashes of original text; owned PC game data remains necessary.
Original voice/audio assets and backing English UK asset paths are unchanged.
Engine source remains subject to the upstream non-commercial license.
